753:t_066:1.en:
$$ジン$$
「It's just like $$エンシェントＡＱ$$'s $$神来無限掌$$! Causality is reversed!」

753:t_066:2.en:
$$カグラ$$
「So the result of a hit comes before the attack?!」

753:t_066:3.en:
$$シリウス$$
「It's an attack we can't evade...! Is this truly divine judgment?!」

753:t_066:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You think a little cheating like this will surprise me now?!」

753:t_066:5.en:
$$アマタ$$
「If we can't dodge it, there's no point thinking about it! We'll beat him before we run out of strength!」

753:t_066:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「If you won't try because it's impossible, shouldn't you give up this battle altogether?」

753:t_066:7.en:
$n
「Do you really have time for idle chatter, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?!」

753:t_066:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「This is advice, $n. You could call it mercy born of my love for you.」

753:t_066:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「If you will not stop resisting, I must punish you further. I advise you to give up quickly.」

753:t_066:11.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then I have no choice. With each passing minute, you will learn that my power is infinite.」

753:t_066:12.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「This is no threat. I have merely stated a fact.」

753:t_067:0.en:
$$弁慶$$
「W-what?! There are more attacks, and they hit harder than a minute ago!」

753:t_067:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I told you. You would learn of my infinite power with each passing minute.」

753:t_067:2.en:
$$隼人$$
「Watch out! The attack a minute from now will be even stronger!」

753:t_067:3.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Damn it! He's on a whole different scale from all the monsters we've fought!」

753:t_067:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So you should give up quickly. Then at least I shall embrace you before you have time to feel pain.」

753:t_067:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is my final gift of mercy to you.」

753:t_068:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We have one minute until the universe collapses!」

753:t_068:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Hurry! If we don't stop $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ in this last minute, everything's over!」

753:t_068:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We'll do it! Otherwise, we couldn't face the people who entrusted their future to us!」

753:t_068:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Damn right! Let's do this, everyone!」

753:t_068:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We'll stake everything on this last minute! Even our lives!」

753:t_069:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It seems to be beginning.」

753:t_069:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Farewell, $c... At the end of myth, I shall pass down the tale of your resistance as the last $$バアル$$.」

753:t_100:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「Aren't you embarrassed to call yourself God?!」

753:t_100:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I now have the power, mind and resolve to merit it. I shall say it with pride.」

753:t_100:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am God, $$勝平$$.」

753:t_100:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! How could I live alongside someone who can kill people with a smile?!」

753:t_100:4.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「That's right, $$勝平$$! If we don't beat him, the universe is finished!」

753:t_100:5.en:
$$恵子$$
「We have to do this! For everyone on Earth... in the whole universe!」

753:t_100:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I am here to free you from that sense of duty to fight.」

753:t_100:7.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We aren't fighting out of duty! We're here of our own free will!」

753:t_100:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「We'll fight! To protect what's precious to us from guys like you!」

753:t_100:9.en:
$$勝平$$
「Let's go, $$ザンボット３$$! This really is our last battle!!」

753:t_101:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$万丈$$... You bear the sun. Your fighting spirit, courage and strong will deserve praise.」

753:t_101:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「I'm honored to meet God's standards. Though I have no intention of recognizing you as God.」

753:t_101:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Then let my sun envelop yours. Perhaps then you will recognize a being greater than yourself.」

753:t_101:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「Even if your power exceeds mine, you cannot make my heart submit!」

753:t_101:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「And I will never be defeated! I'll teach you that!」

753:t_101:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「To burn with such fighting spirit as the universe's end approaches... You truly refuse to accept your end...!」

753:t_101:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! We will not accept the end of the universe!」

753:t_101:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「For the world, for its people, for the universe, $$ダイターン３$$ will crush God's ambition!」

753:t_101:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「If you don't fear the brilliance of this sun, come at me!!」

753:t_102:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Rest easy, $$ワッ太$$. Soon all your little worries and fears will vanish. You too will leave your body and depart for a new world.」

753:t_102:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't decide that for me! I'm not gonna lose to homework or the threat of bankruptcy!」

753:t_102:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Or to some selfish god like you, either!」

753:t_102:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「God has the right to decide everything. No, God must decide everything.」

753:t_102:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It was with that resolve that I became a being beyond the $$御使い$$s!」

753:t_102:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'm a company president too, but I run $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ by working together with everyone around me!」

753:t_102:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's way more fun that way! But a dictatorial control freak like you wouldn't understand!」

753:t_102:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So a human... and the head of a tiny company at that, cannot understand my resolve!」

753:t_102:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You're the one who calls himself God, yet you don't understand anything about me or humanity!」

753:t_102:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Here I come, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! $$トライダー$$ and I will beat you to protect our company's vault and peace on Earth and in space!!」

753:t_103:0.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Everyone, this is our moment of truth!」

753:t_103:1.en:
$$厚井$$
「I know! I'm ready, and I've made up my mind!」

753:t_103:2.en:
$$木下$$
「L-let's do it, everyone! Let's go all out! All out!」

753:t_103:3.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Let's save this universe with our... $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$'s strength!」

753:t_103:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You scrape together what little courage you have to challenge God... The sight is more comical than endearing.」

753:t_103:5.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Be quiet! We are about to defeat you!」

753:t_103:6.en:
$$柿小路$$
「$$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, the universe's jack-of-all-trades! We'll fight alongside our president to the very end!!」

753:t_104:0.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's our final showdown, $$鉄人$$! We'll defeat $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and protect the universe!」

753:t_104:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even if you defeat me, the universe will collapse... Even if it stops, a world without God or the $$御使い$$s will know only lawless chaos.」

753:t_104:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「How could people survive in such a world?!」

753:t_104:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Don't just decide humanity is doomed!」

753:t_104:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Sure, there are bad people...! But there are far more kind, decent people in this world!」

753:t_104:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$正太郎$$... You have seen humanity's ugly side at such a young age. Why can you still believe in them so strongly?」

753:t_104:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm different from you! I love people and this world! That's why I can believe!」

753:t_104:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$鉄人$$! We'll use the last of our strength to protect the world we love!!」

753:t_105:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You needn't be so frightened. I intend to give my great love equally to organic and inorganic beings.」

753:t_105:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even you reject my salvation?」

753:t_105:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$オックス$$ feels it too! You're our enemy... the enemy of everything that exists!」
